qos.name: qos_cpu_rc
notes: The VM-local Slurm demo group advertises 6 CPU and 10 GiB, reserving the remaining host capacity for control-plane services.

dynamic_facts: The target VM has 8 vCPU and about 15.6 GiB Linux-visible memory; its single Slurm demo node exposes the bounded 6-CPU/10-GiB job envelope.
limitations: This is a local/VM release-candidate profile, not a real 107 capability claim.
Per-job Slurm cgroup enforcement is unavailable on this VM; Docker limits the aggregate demo node instead.
GPU partitions, GPU QoS and GPU templates are disabled.
